description.p: Aurora is a free, open-source music player without ads or tracking. Search for any song or artist, build playlists, and start listening.

ul.li: Search for music across multiple sources
Explore new releases, top tracks, and editorial playlists
Extend the player with plugins - add new music sources, metadata providers, and more
Customize the look and feel with themes

screenshot.caption: Browse top tracks, new releases, and editorial playlists
Search for artists across multiple sources
Install plugins to add new music sources and features

ul.li: Mejora integral en la ficha y reproducción de podcasts: texto negro de alto contraste en la cabecera y descripción sobre fondo verde, alineación perfecta sin recorte de la columna 'Duración' en dispositivos móviles, preservación de las carátulas reales de cada episodio sin sobreescrituras por canciones de iTunes, y acción atómica playTracks para reproducir de forma inmediata el episodio pulsado.

Eliminación total del truncamiento de texto en la tabla de episodios y vistas de podcasts: los títulos completos se muestran en múltiples líneas sin puntos suspensivos ni recortes, se oculta la columna redundante de artista dando el ancho completo al título, y se asegura la reproducción del audio exacto del episodio.

Corrige la reproducción de episodios de podcasts para que reproduzcan el audio exacto del episodio en lugar de buscar canciones aleatorias, elimina todo truncamiento de textos y descripciones en la sección de podcasts, y optimiza el diseño en dispositivos móviles para mostrar los episodios inmediatamente.

Ficha completa de podcast integrada con YouTube Music: al hacer click en cualquier podcast desde el buscador o la sección de podcasts se abre la ficha con carátula, autor, descripción y el listado de episodios reproducibles directamente mediante el motor de streaming de YouTube.

Corrige el error 'No se ha podido cargar tu selección' en Android Auto mostrando un estado de buffering inmediato, añade portadas reales a los podcasts descargando imágenes en segundo plano, y arregla las playlists populares para que se reproduzcan directamente sin mostrar una lista vacía.

Renovación gráfica integral de Android Auto: interfaz visual con ContentStyle en cuadrícula, carátulas en alta resolución en todas las canciones, listas y podcasts, tarjetas visuales de búsqueda para conducción y reproducción inmediata de playlists y búsquedas.
Corrige el aviso repetitivo de lista importada al navegar o consultar listas remotas, y llena la vista con listas populares de Spotify y YouTube Music cuando no hay listas personales creadas.
Añade podcasts al buscador, elimina el encabezado grande de búsqueda, prioriza las listas propias y muestra listas públicas populares de YouTube Music sin barras de desplazamiento visibles.
Repara la barra de controles y el modo coche, compacta los artistas favoritos y reproduce podcasts dentro de Aurora.
Ajusta los botones de sincronización y QR para que compartan el ancho disponible en móvil sin desbordarse.
Reordena los controles del modo coche: anterior, reproducir y siguiente arriba; favorito, aleatorio y no me gusta debajo.
Corrige el desbordamiento de la barra de reproducción móvil que apilaba verticalmente el título y el artista.
Compacta las fichas de artistas favoritos en móvil y sustituye el botón de borrado por un control discreto de icono.
Reorganiza la barra móvil: muestra título y artista arriba y agrupa los controles de reproducción en una fila inferior más clara.
Mejora la vista de favoritos de artistas, muestra carátulas de podcasts e iconos de plugins, y hace visibles las listas públicas de Spotify y YouTube Music al buscar listas.
Añade la búsqueda de listas, listas favoritas con corazón y una sección de Podcasts con favoritos en las interfaces compatibles.
Muestra playlists públicas de YouTube Music y Spotify en la sección Listas, con acceso directo a su importación.
Usa el logotipo de Aurora en el icono de Android, Android Auto y Google TV.
Añade el control No me gusta al modo coche y a Android Auto; la canción se marca para excluirla y avanza la reproducción.
Keep complete song titles visible in Android views and correct malformed Spanish text in synchronization settings.
Fix Android responsive overflow in settings, playlists and artists, restore artist avatars and identifiers, and add browsable queue and search actions for Android Auto.
Replace the oversized Android dashboard with compact recommendations and pages sized to the available screen height, keeping the full mix available for playback without scrolling the home screen.
Simplify Android settings, display the Aurora wordmark above search, improve responsive mobile layouts and enable automatic mobile APK update checks and downloads from GitHub Releases.
Fix Android startup logging errors by using the system console when the desktop bridge is unavailable.
Resolve and enable reliable audio and video playback on Google TV and Android TV with seamless track switching and background playback.
Restore artist name display directly under song titles in track tables across all screen sizes and devices.

Add dislike button to now playing bar and track context menu actions to blacklist songs and artists, instantly skipping tracks, applying score penalties, and excluding them from recommendations across synced devices.
Make music discovery and queue autoplay completely automatic and seamless in the background; remove the misleading and redundant discovery button from the player controls bar.

Add user-owned cloud synchronization via WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud, NAS) and private GitHub Gists, manual library backup export/import, and instant pairing via QR code configuration between desktop and mobile devices.

Use direct audio output, respect playback interruptions, block playback during phone calls, restore selection of resolved queue tracks and simplify car controls. Keep video controls exclusive to Google TV, avoid competing TV update downloads, and wait for desktop installation before offering a restart.

Refresh mobile and desktop presentation with clearer navigation, responsive playback controls and safe-area spacing. Remove full-screen blur transitions while preserving existing actions, themes and Google TV presentation.

Rebuild Google TV with a lightweight Spanish interface, fixed playback controls, deterministic remote navigation, single button activation and optional music videos. Preserve mobile and desktop behavior.
Make history rankings interactive: play songs and open artist and album pages by clicking their names, including individual artist credits.
Restore Spanish recommendation text and keep the Panel list fixed while playing. Apply newly learned recommendations on the next visit instead of reshuffling the visible list.

Keep listening preferences learning across mobile and desktop, including partial plays and skips. Merge offline listening without losing or duplicating plays, and refresh personalized recommendations when preferences change.
Prefer AAC-LC and stereo HLS audio renditions over the first low-quality HE-AAC track when resolving songs on Android.

Complete rebranding to Aurora. Fixed desktop audio playback by prioritizing yt-dlp on Tauri. Added audio focus handling to pause music during phone calls. Filtered YouTube Music search to exclude live streams and long videos. Removed TV/Google TV support. Updated all Android app icons to Aurora design.
Enhanced MediaSession synchronization with decoupled web/native bridge initialization, non-blocking metadata subscriptions, and comprehensive Android AudioForegroundService diagnostics.

Added on-device hidden WebView YouTube stream extractor plugin with two-stage fallback (embed -> m.youtube.com), robust MIME audio filtering, leak-free lifecycle cleanup, and unified mobile User-Agent synchronization.

Fixed infinite buffering by migrating YouTube direct audio stream resolution to VISIONOS HLS master manifest streams with sub-playlist parsing, eliminating 403 Forbidden errors and bot PoToken challenges across all songs.

Restored universal HTML5 audio playback across all platforms, enabled reliable static visitor ID fallback for instant YouTube stream extraction, and bound native low-latency silent AudioTrack keep-alive to ensure uninterrupted screen-off background playback and instant lockscreen widget response on Xiaomi HyperOS 3.
Implemented direct stream extraction for Android to bypass Chromium WebView limitations and permanently fix background playback.
Fixed automatic update checks on Android and added signed desktop update packages.
Fixed Android playback stopping when the screen turns off or the app is backgrounded, and made the Google TV layout adapt to the visible screen size.
Fixed pressing Enter in the search box searching for a hovered recent search instead of the typed text.
Clickable artist/track title in the player bar
Fixed various Appimage issues caused by Wayland.
Fixed playback stopping after double clicking a track in the queue.
Fixed duplicate entries appearing in the listening history.
Fixed the previous track briefly playing when starting a new track before its stream is ready.
Aurora starts maximized by default
Aurora Jam remote control now supports searching for music, adding tracks to the queue, and removing tracks from the queue.
Playlists can now be sorted.
Playlists can now be filtered.
History stats tab shows a selection of charts showcasing your listening habits.
Fix bluetooth issues on Linux.
Tracks that failed to resolve their streams now retry with a fresh search when you come back to them. When no streaming provider is installed, the error message now prompts you to install one.
Fix streaming getting permanently stuck at 10s intervals.
Listening history: Aurora now keeps a history of the tracks you play. Can be disabled in the preferences.
Fix playback stalling at 10-second fMP4 segment boundaries (0:09, 0:19, 0:29...) when streaming via yt-dlp, caused by sub-frame gaps between appended segments
Theme loading performance improvements
Recent searches appear under the search box, with keyboard navigation and one-click history clearing
Search box with clear button, search icon, Escape to clear, and URL sync
Fix audio going silent after about a second over Bluetooth on Linux
Fix yt-dlp playback stalling at segment boundaries (e.g. 0:09, 0:29) when buffered audio drifted past the next segment's start time
Fix marketplace themes resetting to default on restart
Custom title bar for frameless window mode. Enable in Settings -> Appearance
Fix HLS playback failing on Windows with Chromium 147+
We're temporarily switching to nightly yt-dlp due to a regression. This will fix playlist imports.
Navigate to playlists directly from artist pages that have them
Fix the queue getting stuck at the end of some tracks, where playback parked a fraction of a second before the end and never advanced to the next track
Right-click a queue item to see its stream candidates and switch to a different source; picking a failed source retries it
Fix TSX plugins failing with 'React is not defined' unless they imported React manually, and fix stale plugin code being served when an imported file changed but the entry file didn't
The window now remembers its size, position, and maximized state between restarts
Aurora Jam lets you control playback from any device on your local network. Enable it in Settings -> Integrations, then scan the QR code with your phone.
Fix HLS tracks getting stuck at 0:00 when the queue advances
Fix tracks failing to play in saved playlists and in queues restored after restart by re-resolving stream URLs when they expire
MPD server lets you control Aurora from MPD clients like mpc and ncmpcpp
Installed plugins are automatically updated to the latest version on startup
Fix legacy playlist import failing when track durations use mm:ss or hh:mm:ss format
Fix source selection being reset to the first available provider on startup
Show an empty state in Sources when no providers of a given kind are installed
Streaming providers can now access full track metadata when resolving streams
Fix paired streaming provider not activating when registered after the metadata provider
Frameless window toggle in settings
Back and forward navigation buttons in the top bar
Theme store for browsing and installing community themes
Discord rich presence integration
Plugins can provide music discovery recommendations based on the current queue
Introduce dark mode as persistent preference
Fix issues with tables being way too wide with longer track titles
Aurora is now built from source for Flatpak, with new app icons
Fixed album tracks being added to the queue without thumbnails
Dashboard, search, and plugins views now prompt to install plugins when none are active
AUR packages are now automatically updated when a new release is published
Fixed a console window briefly appearing on Windows each time yt-dlp was invoked
Queue items are now correctly restored when restarting Aurora.
New Sources view lets you switch the active metadata and streaming providers from the sidebar
yt-dlp is now downloaded and updated automatically at runtime, fixing Flatpak and AppImage compatibility
Border width is now themable - advanced themes can set border-width to control all borders in the app
Improved dark mode for all basic themes with better backgrounds, toned-down primaries, and themed borders
Update badge shows download progress and lets you click to update or restart
Social links in settings sidebar (Discord, GitHub, Mastodon, Website)
Fixed repeat, shuffle, and volume for MSE streams
Plugins can import YouTube playlists by URL via yt-dlp
YouTube tracks now play using MSE-based streaming, fixing incorrect duration display and enabling proper seeking
Customizable keyboard shortcuts with settings UI for rebinding
Plugin event bus with trackFinished and trackStarted events
Custom settings widgets for plugins (render React components in settings UI)
Shell API for plugins to open URLs in the system browser
Plugins can use Aurora UI components (Button, Toggle, etc.)
Fixed plugin settings using wrong storage key (core prefix instead of plugin prefix)
Fixed old audio stream continuing to play when switching tracks or clearing the queue
In-app changelog in settings (What's New tab)
Release pipeline auto-generates GitHub release notes from changelog data
Support importing legacy format playlists (from legacy format)
Migrated repository to danidetenerife/aurora
Playlist import from URL
Playlist provider adapter view with cover art
Fixed loading status getting stuck on stream resolution
MCP server for controlling Aurora from AI agents and other tools
Plugin store with browsing, search, and installation
Flatpak packaging
Fixed various Appimage issues caused by Wayland.
Fixed playback stopping after double clicking a track in the queue.
Fixed duplicate entries appearing in the listening history.
Fixed the previous track briefly playing when starting a new track before its stream is ready.
Aurora starts maximized by default
Fix the queue getting stuck at the end of some tracks, where playback parked a fraction of a second before the end and never advanced to the next track
Right-click a queue item to see its stream candidates and switch to a different source; picking a failed source retries it
